description: Get the connected account’s saved business identity, voice, visual style and content strategy: the business facts and contact details, the words and tone to use or avoid, the logo and other visual assets, products, offers, FAQs and objections, the service area and the owner’s own story, plus compliance notes naming the claims to avoid. Use these values exactly as saved; never invent a brand fact the profile does not carry. Returns null when no brand profile has been saved.
name: soclo_brand_get
title: Read your Soclo brand
